title: mumps4py: A complete Python interface for the MUMPS sparse direct solver
description: mumps4py is a Python interface to MUMPS (MUltifrontal Massively Parallel Sparse direct Solver). It wraps the full MUMPS C API through a low-overhead Cython layer, integrates with NumPy and mpi4py, and supports all four MUMPS arithmetics (real/complex, single/double) as well as centralized and distributed assembly, elemental input, sparse right-hand sides and Schur complement computation.
